questions.stem: Which title fits best?
questions.explanation: The answer is “Helping Store Costumes While Waiting for a Ride”. Evidence: Our drama club meets at the community hall during the school holidays. Dad will pick me up in his car when the afternoon practice finishes. While I wait, I help the teacher check the costume cupboard. We put away the heavy winter coats to keep them safe until next season. The teacher folds each coat, and I place it in a clean storage box. Dad arrives just as we finish writing a label for the box. questions.parentExplanation: 正确项为“Helping Store Costumes While Waiting for a Ride”。原文依据：放假时，我们戏剧社在社区大厅集合。下午练习结束时，爸爸会开车来接我。等待时，我帮老师检查装戏服的柜子。我们把厚重的冬季外套存好，安全留到下个季节使用。老师把每件外套叠好，我把它放进干净的收纳箱。我们刚写好箱子的标签，爸爸就到了。我和他一起离开，很高兴下次社团需要时，戏服仍能拿出来用。

questions.stem: What is the main idea?
questions.explanation: The answer is “A tired journey helps Ben change his bedtime plan.”. Evidence: Ben wants to leave early for a family trip on Saturday. He stays up very late playing a game on Friday night. In the morning, he needs to make the bed before packing his last things. He rushes through his jobs because he woke later than planned. He begins to pay for his late night when he feels too tired to enjoy the journey. At the first stop, he rests quietly instead of joining a short walk. That evening, he chooses an earlier bedtime so he can enjoy the next day's visit.
questions.parentExplanation: 正确项为“A tired journey helps Ben change his bedtime plan.”。原文依据：本想周六早些出发参加家庭旅行。周五晚上，他玩游戏玩到很晚。早晨，他需要先整理床铺，再收拾最后几样东西。由于醒得比计划晚，他匆匆忙忙地做完事情。旅途中，他累得无法尽兴，开始为前一晚熬夜付出代价。第一次停车休息时，他安静休息，没有参加短途散步。那晚，他选择早睡，好享受第二天的参观。

translation.stem: 这篇短文的主旨是什么？
